title: Amber Creative
line: The website of a digital marketing agency in Singapore.
problem: Amber Creative is a digital marketing agency in Singapore that provides branding, web development and paid media services. Its own website needed new sections, better visibility on search engines and a way for the team to update the content themselves.
did: As a Software Developer Intern, I built responsive UI components, connected the pages to a CMS so the team could update them on their own and implemented SEO improvements. I also worked on new features, bug fixes and optimising the codebase.
outcome: The website now works smoothly across all devices, and the team can update its content without needing a developer.

story.title: Situation
story.body: Amber Creative is a digital marketing agency in Singapore that provides branding, web development and paid media services. Its own website needed new sections, better visibility on search engines and a way for the team to update the content themselves.

story.title: Task
story.body: As a Software Developer Intern, I was responsible for helping to develop and maintain the agency's own website.

story.title: Action
story.body: I built responsive UI components with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, and connected the pages to Directus CMS and Storyblok CMS so the team could update them on their own. I also implemented SEO improvements, worked on new features and bug fixes, and optimised the codebase.

story.title: Result
story.body: The website now works smoothly across all devices, and the team can update its content without needing a developer.

notes: Written with STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result).
